author: Phrez
quote:
This Game is so much afraid to offend someone that its purely lost what made GTA special. The funny cutscenes, the stereotyp insults, going insane in the Hospital or night clubs and shooting everybody. U took all those iconic memories away. The fact that u cant steal any car or kill every NPC is so immersion breaking. 
And in addition to that locking the game to 30fps with dips into the low 20s in 2026 is just insane. And i have not even talked about the buggy mess. Cyberpunk got canceled for that, but here we let it slide. It feels like we got scammed by the publisher we trusted the most. Feels bad dude...
